mapper.select: SELECT t1.position_code, t1.position_name FROM safety_employee_message t1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT MIN(id) AS id FROM safety_employee_message WHERE position_code IS NOT NULL AND position_code != '' AND position_name IS NOT NULL AND position_name != '' GROUP BY position_code ) t2 ON t1.id = t2.id ORDER BY t1.position_code;

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM safety_employee_message a WHERE a.status = 'NORMAL' AND ( ( a.user_type != 'WX' AND a.photo IS NOT NULL AND photo != '' ) OR ( a.user_type = 'WX' AND a.emp_login IS NOT NULL AND a.emp_login != '' AND a.photo IS NOT NULL AND a.photo != '' ) ) AND a.photo_update_time < (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 1 YEAR) and NOT EXISTS( select 1 from safety_build_in_out_history b where b.oper_time > #{dateStr} and b.emp_no = a.emp_no group by b.emp_no )
